title: A policy variable in a Bool condition
question: Are policy variables filled in in a Bool value? The condition operators page says Bool supports them, and the policy variables page says it doesn't. The analyzer refuses.

readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: it isn't: the text ${aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent} never equals true

cases.name: mfa_false
cases.description: aws:SecureTransport is true and aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent is false.

readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: the variable is filled in, and true isn't false; or it isn't filled in at all
